mainEntity.name: Can someone see how many times you view their profile?

acceptedAnswer.text: No—Instagram never shares this information. You can visit any profile as often as you want without the other person knowing.

mainEntity.name: Can business or creator accounts see who viewed their profile?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Professional accounts can only see the total number of profile visits and general demographic data—not specific visitors.

mainEntity.name: Are there any legitimate apps to check profile viewers?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Any app or service claiming to reveal your Instagram profile viewers is misleading and potentially dangerous.

mainEntity.name: Can someone see if you viewed their Instagram profile picture?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Viewing someone's profile picture does not trigger any notification, and there is no way for users to see who has viewed their profile photo.

mainEntity.name: Can you see who viewed your Instagram Highlights?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Highlights are made up of Stories, but once a Story becomes a Highlight, you can no longer see who viewed it.

mainEntity.name: Can I use Apple Pay online?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, many websites and apps now accept Apple Pay as a payment option.

mainEntity.name: Which browsers support Apple Pay?

acceptedAnswer.text: Apple Pay works in Safari on iPhone, iPad, and Mac.

mainEntity.name: How do I know if a store accepts Apple Pay?

acceptedAnswer.text: Look for the Apple Pay or contactless symbol at checkout, or check in Apple Maps.

mainEntity.name: Are there fees for using Apple Pay?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, Apple Pay does not charge users any fees.

mainEntity.name: Can I use Apple Pay at small businesses?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes! Many small and independent merchants now accept Apple Pay. If you see the contactless symbol at checkout, you can use Apple Pay.

mainEntity.name: Why do some major stores not accept Apple Pay?

acceptedAnswer.text: Some retailers have chosen to develop their own mobile payment systems, or have not upgraded their payment terminals to support NFC. Others may have business reasons for not supporting Apple Pay.

title.rendered: Download the Official iPadOS 26 Wallpapers in 4K

content.rendered:
Apple has rolled out a major update for iPad users with the release of iPadOS 26, packed with exciting new features and a stunning redesign. One of the most eye-catching elements of this update is the official iPadOS 26 wallpaper, which showcases Apple’s sleek Liquid Glass aesthetic—now consistent across iOS 26, iPadOS 26, and macOS 26 Tahoe. Available in both Light and Dark modes, this wallpaper gives your iPad a polished, futuristic look.

Download the Official iPadOS 26 Wallpapers in 4K Now 

The best part? You don’t need to wait for the public release of iPadOS 26 to enjoy the fresh visual update. Apple fans can instantly download the official iPadOS 26 wallpaper in 4K resolution and bring the new design language to life on their iPad’s Home or Lock Screen.

Download Light | Download Dark

Download Light | Download Dark

A Glimpse into the macOS 26 and iPadOS 26 Design Language

Just like macOS 26 Tahoe and iOS 26, iPadOS 26 uses the Liquid Glass interface, a translucent and refractive visual style that gives your screen depth and motion. This wallpaper reflects that design beautifully—it’s more than just a background; it’s a visual preview of Apple’s evolving software identity across all platforms.

With its abstract, overlapping shapes in rich cobalt blue and aqua green tones, the wallpaper offers a frosted-glass texture and subtle shadows that enhance its 3D feel. The clean, modern aesthetic complements the new windowing system and redesigned apps introduced in iPadOS 26 and macOS 26 features.

Why Should You Download the iPadOS 26 Wallpaper?

Still on the fence about downloading? Here’s why it’s worth it:

  • Instant Refresh: Get the Liquid Glass design on your iPad without installing the iPadOS 26 beta.
  • 4K Quality: The wallpaper looks sharp and vibrant—perfect for iPads with Liquid Retina XDR displays.
  • Optimized for Light & Dark Mode: It adapts beautifully to system settings for a seamless experience.

title.rendered: macOS 26 Tahoe Features Unveiled: Everything You Need to Know

content.rendered:
Apple officially unveiled macOS 26 at WWDC 2025—and it’s not just another update. Dubbed macOS 26 Tahoe, this version introduces a brand-new design language, deep iPhone integration, and Apple Intelligence features that elevate your Mac experience in ways never seen before.

Here’s everything you need to know about macOS 26 Tahoe, including why Apple named it that, what’s new, and when you’ll get it.

Why Is It Called macOS 26 Tahoe?

Apple is moving away from version-number naming conventions and shifting to a year-based naming system. Since this version will be widely used in 2026, it’s now macOS 26.

And true to tradition, Apple named the update after a California landmark—Lake Tahoe. So, the official name is macOS 26 Tahoe.

What’s New in macOS 26 Tahoe?

macOS 26 Tahoe is Apple’s most intelligent, personal, and interconnected macOS yet. Here’s what sets it apart:

1. A Stunning New “Liquid Glass” Design

Apple has reimagined the macOS interface with a modern, immersive design called Liquid Glass, inspired by visionOS.

  • Transparent menu bars that blend into the wallpaper
  • Color-matched app icons and folders
  • Light and dark tint customizations
  • Custom emojis and symbols for folders

It’s sleek, fluid, and makes the Mac feel more futuristic.

2. iPhone Calls on Mac with the New Phone App

You can now make and manage iPhone calls right from your Mac:

  • Access call history, voicemails, and contacts
  • Call Screening to check unknown caller details
  • Hold Assist waits on hold for you and alerts when it’s your turn

Your Mac becomes your phone hub—no need to switch devices.

3. Live Activities in the Menu Bar

Live Activities on Mac show real-time updates for apps like Uber, food delivery, or flights right in the menu bar.

Click them to instantly open the corresponding iPhone app via iPhone Mirroring.

4. Spotlight Just Got Smarter

Spotlight in macOS 26 Tahoe evolves into a command center:

  • Run shortcuts, send messages, or play music
  • Use smart filters and Quick Keys
  • Perform tasks without switching apps

This transforms how you interact with your Mac’s search tool.

5. Apple Intelligence Expands on Mac

macOS 26 integrates Apple Intelligence, Apple’s on-device AI layer, to boost personalization while protecting your privacy.

  • Live Translations during calls and chats
  • Context-aware reminders from emails or notes
  • Genmoji and Image Playground for creating custom visuals
  • Smarter Shortcuts that learn from your behavior

Whether you’re working, creating, or organizing, AI is now your co-pilot.

6. Apple Games App: A New Era for Mac Gaming

Apple is finally giving Mac gaming its due with the new Apple Games app.

  • Launch and manage all games in one place
  • New Game Overlay for in-game settings, voice chat, and invites
  • Metal 4 support enhances graphics and FPS
  • Support for major titles like Cyberpunk 2077 and Crimson Desert

Bonus: The app is also available on iPhone and iPad.

7. App Updates: Safari, Messages, Notes, and More

macOS 26 Tahoe brings improvements across the board:

  • Safari: Faster, more secure, improved ad tracking protection
  • Messages: Polls, group typing indicators, custom chat backgrounds
  • Notes: Markdown support and auto-transcription from audio
  • FaceTime & Photos: Liquid Glass redesign
  • Passwords: Now includes password history and update tracking
  • Journal: Finally arrives on Mac

8. Accessibility Upgrades in macOS 26

Apple continues to focus on inclusivity with powerful new accessibility features:

  • Magnifier with iPhone camera: Turns your phone into a live zoom lens
  • Vehicle Motion Cues: Reduces screen-induced motion sickness
  • Accessibility Reader: Offers simplified reading views with custom fonts and colors
  • Braille Access: Full system integration with braille devices for navigation and note-taking

Compatibility and Release Schedule

macOS 26 Tahoe will be available for a wide range of Macs—check the full list of supported models here.

Release Timeline:

  • Developer Beta: Available Now
  • Public Beta: July 2025
  • Official Release: Fall 2025

Related: How to Install macOS Tahoe Developer Beta on Your Mac

Final Thoughts

macOS 26 Tahoe isn’t just a visual refresh—it redefines how your Mac fits into your Apple ecosystem. From AI features and cross-device control to enhanced gaming and productivity, this update reflects Apple’s future-forward vision.

If you’re using a Mac daily, macOS 26 will reshape your experience visually, functionally, and intelligently.

Stay tuned—we’ll dive deeper with hands-on insights when the public beta arrives!

acceptedAnswer.text: No—Instagram never shares this information. You can visit any profile as often as you want without the other person knowing.

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Professional accounts can only see the total number of profile visits and general demographic data—not specific visitors.

mainEntity.name: Are there any legitimate apps to check profile viewers?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Any app or service claiming to reveal your Instagram profile viewers is misleading and potentially dangerous.

mainEntity.name: Can I use Apple Pay online?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, many websites and apps now accept Apple Pay as a payment option.

mainEntity.name: Which browsers support Apple Pay?

acceptedAnswer.text: Apple Pay works in Safari on iPhone, iPad, and Mac.

mainEntity.name: How do I know if a store accepts Apple Pay?

acceptedAnswer.text: Look for the Apple Pay or contactless symbol at checkout, or check in Apple Maps.

mainEntity.name: Are there fees for using Apple Pay?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, Apple Pay does not charge users any fees.

mainEntity.name: Can I use Apple Pay at small businesses?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes! Many small and independent merchants now accept Apple Pay. If you see the contactless symbol at checkout, you can use Apple Pay.

mainEntity.name: Why do some major stores not accept Apple Pay?

acceptedAnswer.text: Some retailers have chosen to develop their own mobile payment systems, or have not upgraded their payment terminals to support NFC. Others may have business reasons for not supporting Apple Pay.
